item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. No notes logged today, so I'm working blind on this one — that's on you to fix. Between meditation, therapy-style check-ins, and evening wind-down, your day has structure, but structure doesn't take medication for you. Build it into an existing anchor, don't leave it floating. Action: log it right after your midday check-in today.
